TC-09/S18.title: Nothing changes unless the physician confirms: an empty read, 'Decide later', or closing the sheet
TC-09/S18.detail: Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S18: 10/10 judged pass — (a) a header-only page read as no rows: the sheet says 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', offers no Add button, and nothing is added or changed; (b) the mixed photo, 'Add 7 to Today's Visits', the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet asks about the repeated Juniper row, 'Decide later', close the scan sheet: nothing written (no Juniper / Kestrel / Nursing Home Ivy, Gum still off today, the fixture resident and Fir still on today; backend identical to the start); (c) the mixed photo again, closed at the summary without Add: Today's Visits and All Residents unchanged, backend identical. Whether the empty-read message is clear enough is for a person: 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (screenshot tc09-s18-s18-blank.png).
